dataset.note: The public release contains train and validation only; the 108,501 in the paper include images that were not released.
dataset.label_provenance: annotator-perceived labels (Amazon Mechanical Turk), not self-identification

router.standardisation: robust: (x - median) / (IQR / 1.349), statistics over all images with landmarks

top1_definition: argmax of the seven router probabilities

shape_label.model: train-set table P(group | top-1 label), add-1 smoothing

shape_probabilities.model: standardise + multinomial logistic regression (lbfgs, L2, C=1); balanced accuracy from a class_weight='balanced' fit

ratio_features.model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (sklearn defaults, random_state=20261017); balanced accuracy from a class_weight='balanced' fit
